methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Weakest to ranged (magic not recommended). Draconic - dragonbane (DH crossbow / lance) is effective.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Weakest to ranged (magic not recommended). Draconic - dragonbane (DH crossbow / lance) is effective.

methods.label: Vent lure and prayer rotation
methods.summary: Lure Hydra onto the correct chemical vents and switch prayers as its attack style changes every three attacks.
steps: Start with the correct protection prayer for the current attack style and count three attacks before switching.
Move Hydra onto the matching coloured chemical vent in each phase to remove its damage reduction.
Keep attacking with ranged or dragonbane weapons while repositioning between vents.
Reset positioning quickly after each phase transition.
risks: Using the wrong vent makes the fight much slower.
Losing the three-attack rhythm causes heavy magic or ranged hits.

methods.label: Special attacks and Jad phase
methods.summary: Handle poison, lightning, and flame specials, then alternate prayers correctly during the final Jad-style phase.
steps: Move away from poison splats and do not stand in lingering poison pools.
Run around the lightning path rather than crossing it late.
For the flame wall and tracking flame, move decisively to avoid being pinned.
In the final phase, alternate protection prayers each attack instead of every three attacks.
risks: Lightning and flame specials can kill through otherwise good DPS.
The final phase punishes stale prayer switching.
